dict.string: iterate lets your mind see the camera, and shows it in its menu. You can forbid it in the menu.
iterate writes what you dictate, on this Mac, and lets your mind hear the microphone. You can forbid the mind in the menu.
iterate connects directly to a person of your mind on this network who watches this Mac live. You can forbid the screen, the camera and the microphone in the menu.
iterate runs commands for your mind; a command may ask another app to do something. You can forbid commands in the menu.
